posts.title: don't bend! ascend!
posts.description: (originally written 8/30, a month ago) hello! Today is the day that I move into university. I am, expectedly, so incredibly nervous. But I am so glad that I am able to be here. Jo (written on 9/30) hello! It's been a month since I've settled into university here, and a lot's changed. I've had high highs that have been diametrically opposed by the largest volume of anxiety that I've had in a while.
